rubric.statement: Defines a blocking synchronous callable that sleeps, wraps it with `dspy.asyncify`, and exercises the asyncified wrapper rather than calling the sync function directly.
Fans out multiple invocations of the asyncified callable with `asyncio.gather` so the program actually tests concurrent execution.
Runs the gathered workload inside `dspy.context(async_max_workers=...)` and repeats it under more than one worker limit, making worker count the setting being tested.
Measures elapsed time around the awaited batch and includes an assertion that the observed runtime reflects worker-limited batching, such as a materially faster higher-capacity run.
Connects the timing behavior to DSPy's implementation detail that `asyncify` uses a shared `CapacityLimiter` whose token count tracks `async_max_workers`, so the worker limit is an active throttle.
